## Changes: * #3094: Move to generator for perf * #2859: Bump undici from 7.11.0 to 7.18.2 * #3086: Excluding worktrees from uri handler * #3091: tools: add confirmation logic to CreateDirectoryTool * #3090: feat(settings): add ClaudeSettingsChangeTracker to monitor settings file changes * #2869: Bump diff from 8.0.2 to 8.0.3 * #3048: build(deps): bump lodash from 4.17.21 to 4.17.23 * #3047: Improved MCP tool call rendering for background agents * #3052: Support reading files outside of the current workspace * #3088: tools: skip diff display when content is identical after trim
See More * #3085: Add categories to token count * #3087: fix: move model provider preference header assignment inside messages… * #3083: Small fixes for github organization instructions * #3084: remove redundant cancellation handling * #3081: ghost: fix: align finishReason behavior in fetchAndStreamCompletions2 * #3079: completionsFetchService: migrate off of AsyncIterableObject to native async generators * #3078: Ask questions tool: add free text mode and improve UX/prompt * #3076: Speed up external ingest * #3073: Update finish reason for MessagesAPI * #3080: Fix "sorry, I can't assist with that" in chat titles * #3074: Support new context widget * #3077: Update model capabilities * #3072: Git - ensure active repository is set upon startup * #2310: Add support for organization custom instructions * #3069: More fixes and cleanup for external ingest * #3071: relax when clause for filtering cloud agent options * #3067: Show confirmation message once workspace index has been built * #3070: Background - close the multi-file diff editor after applying the changes * #3050: Check for max_prompt_images and fail early * #3068: tools: add confirmations for notebook edits * #2857: tools: add support for model-specific tool registration * #3062: Add NES rename functionality and testing improvements * #3042: fix: disable context editing for Anthropic Messages API * #3065: External ingest: Retry on all 500s and add client telemetry on failures * #3066: Surface more external ingest errors to callers * #3049: Add test coverage for feedbackgenerator * #3059: Remove Copilot Extension Dependency This list of changes was [auto generated](https://dev.azure.com/monacotools/Monaco/_build/results?buildId=396301&view=logs).
